schedule: before 9am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Major bumps soak for a month before they are offered.

react and react-dom must move together. Bumping one alone leaves the other's peer range unsatisfiable and fails the docs build - that is why the two split Dependabot PRs (#1, #2) were both permanently red. Docusaurus 3.10 accepts ^18 || ^19, so the pair itself is fine; only the splitting was not.

Mirrors the cap in pyproject.toml. PyDBML still calls pyparsing's pre-PEP8 escChar alias, which warns from 3.3 and dies under filterwarnings = ["error"], taking out test collection entirely. Lift this and the pyproject cap together once PyDBML ships the snake_case API.
Docusaurus packages move as a set; a partial bump leaves the preset and core on different versions.
